description: Add or update an n8n server connection. For a new profile or key rotation, set N8N_MANAGER_API_KEY and N8N_MANAGER_SERVER_URL in the MCP host environment. Existing keys are preserved unless rotate_key is true.

is_default.description: Optional default policy: omitted preserves an existing server's flag; true promotes this server; false explicitly removes its default flag.

rotate_key.description: Explicitly replace the existing stored key from the MCP host environment. Required to change an existing server URL.

name: n8n_add_server
